item.text:
The dashboard now pre-renders its heading and placeholders for every section. The data request runs inside a Suspense boundary, so it no longer holds up the shell. I also enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3).

`npm run build` passes, and I verified that the generated HTML contains the heading and all section placeholders. Runtime data loading remains unverified because the app fetches from `api.example.com`.
